name: @switchback/ingest-worker
description: Azure Functions host for the ingest queue: a Service Bus trigger that drains one job per message.
//concurrency: Two concurrent Overpass requests per host instance, one instance except across a recycle. The ceiling rests on the scale limit in ingest.bicep times the one OverpassClient singleton in packages/ingest/src/config.ts, which caps itself at 2 — not on host.json's maxConcurrentCalls, which the host multiplies by the instance's core count. README.md traces the whole chain, including the app settings this workspace does not own.
//timeout: host.json's functionTimeout is 10 minutes and Consumption will not raise it. OVERPASS_MAX_TOTAL_MS, set in ingest.bicep, is what keeps one query's retry budget under that; see the reconciliation in infra/azure/ingest.bicep.
